div.span:
Solid indigo = the machine path, run without a person. Dashed amber = the only three places a person must decide. Dashed rose = the failure that step exists to catch.
The amber rail down the left is the return path: QA failures and reconciliation gaps go back to the contract, never to a workaround. Evidence date: 31 August 2026.
